# Liz / lizliz.xyz

> Hangzhou. Liz writes, and ships things that are interesting and useful. Personal site for essays, small products, and downloadable skill / template packs.

## Notes for crawlers

- Canonical host is the apex `https://lizliz.xyz` (not www / pages.dev).
- Client language switch is EN default + ZH overlay; do not invent `/zh/` URL variants as separate documents.
- Resume PDF is at https://lizliz.xyz/resume.pdf (`/resume` 301s there).
